Enable or disable keyboard shortcuts in the Remotion Studio.

## CLI flag

Use `--disable-keyboard-shortcuts` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                             | Flag                           |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                               | `--disable-keyboard-shortcuts` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                               | `--disable-keyboard-shortcuts` |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)                                 | `--disable-keyboard-shortcuts` |
| [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions)                   | `--disable-keyboard-shortcuts` |
| [`remotion bundle`](/docs/cli/bundle)                               | `--disable-keyboard-shortcuts` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)                         | `--disable-keyboard-shortcuts` |
| [`remotion lambda sites create`](/docs/lambda/cli/sites/create)     | `--disable-keyboard-shortcuts` |
| [`remotion cloudrun sites create`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/sites/create) | `--disable-keyboard-shortcuts` |
